top_comments.author: AtomBoy
top_comments.body: I'm seeing the same thing. I can chat, but not use the VS Code plugin or claude tool. It's been over 12 hours since my limit reset and /usage seems to think I'm ok, but any prompt just gets: API Error: Rate limit reached. I'm on Tahoe 26.3 on Apple silicon. claude.ai shows my limit has reset and I can use it normally there. Troubleshooting steps I've tried with n
